title.en: An Act Declaring June 20 of Every Year A Special Working Holiday in the Municipality of Guinayangan, Province of Quezon, in Commemoration of Its Founding Anniversary
title.orig: An Act Declaring June 20 of Every Year A Special Working Holiday in the Municipality of Guinayangan, Province of Quezon, in Commemoration of Its Founding Anniversary
title.vi: Đạo luật tuyên bố ngày 20 tháng 6 hằng năm là ngày làm việc lễ đặc biệt tại Đô thị Guinayangan, Tỉnh Quezon, nhân kỷ niệm Ngày Thành lập của địa phương
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติประกาศให้วันที่ 20 มิถุนายนของทุกปีเป็นวันทำงานพิเศษในเทศบาล Guinayangan จังหวัด Quezon เนื่องในโอกาสวันสถาปนา
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan tanggal 20 Juni setiap tahun sebagai hari kerja khusus di Kotamadya Guinayangan, Provinsi Quezon, dalam rangka memperingati Hari Jadi
title.ms: Akta mengisytiharkan 20 Jun setiap tahun sebagai hari bekerja khas di Perbandaran Guinayangan, Wilayah Quezon, sempena memperingati Hari Penubuhan

text.en: June 20 of every year is hereby declared a special working holiday in the Municipality of Guinayangan, Province of Quezon, in commemoration of its founding anniversary. Upon proclamation of the President, June 20 of every year shall be a special non-working holiday in the Municipality of Guinayangan, Province of Quezon.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
